prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web homepage direction comp, landscape 16:10
Primary request: Design the complete first viewport of the Astrid Nails & Beauty Bar website for Lucena City in the category-standard “Soft Luxury Salon” visual world, executed with exceptional restraint. This is a real salon booking product, not a poster or photograph.
Scene/backdrop: warm premium salon atmosphere translated into a clear responsive web interface
Subject: salon introduction, treatment discovery, proof from completed-visit reviews, and online appointment booking
Style/medium: polished production-realistic beauty-service website UI mockup
Composition/framing: 1536-by-960-like landscape viewport; navigation with Astrid Nails & Beauty Bar at left and Services, Reviews, About, Login, Book at right; familiar split hero with headline “Beauty care, booked around you.”, short supporting copy mentioning Lucena City, primary action “Book an appointment”, secondary action “Explore services”; one large unbranded salon photo with two smaller treatment crops; the next fold begins with three clean service cards using real facts: “Gel Polish — ₱1,500 · 60 min”, “Spa Treatment — ₱1,200 · 60 min”, “Lash Extension — ₱1,800 · 60 min”
Color palette: porcelain #faf8f5, deep plum #6b21a8, blush #ec4899, warm gold #f59e0b, ink #241c35
Materials/textures: polished white surfaces, soft tonal fields, restrained beauty photography, subtle warm paper texture
Text (verbatim): “Astrid Nails & Beauty Bar”; “Beauty care, booked around you.”; “Lucena City”; “Book an appointment”; “Explore services”; “Gel Polish”; “₱1,500 · 60 min”; “Spa Treatment”; “₱1,200 · 60 min”; “Lash Extension”; “₱1,800 · 60 min”
Constraints: familiar and immediately understandable; accessible text contrast; one clear primary action; no third-party logos; no false ratings, counts, awards, years, staff counts, certifications, hygiene claims, or exact address; this must read as a functional website
Avoid: excessive gradients, glassmorphism blur, generic icon tiles, emoji, unsupported testimonials, poster layout, illegible decorative text, watermark
